answer: Make every identity climb a spiral of sequential puzzles: each rung can only be solved after the one below it, so a thousand fake faces cannot be minted in parallel — each must wait its turn, epoch after epoch. A lotus of trust blooms only at the top of an unbroken spiral, where every rung is witnessed by unrelated peers. An identity that stalls or forks falls back into the river of probation and restarts the climb, forfeiting its locked stake. Forging a thousand faces means climbing a thousand spirals and locking a thousand stakes.
